> If a retainer suffers a point of damage outside of combat, ie by cryptic

Never. Damage done to retainers outside of combat reduce their life
permanently.

Flux

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
> "Jason" <no...@here.com> wrote:
> > If a retainer suffers a point of damage outside of combat, ie by
> cryptic
> > mission or someother card, when , if ever, does it heal?
>

> [It] never heals from it.

Correct. The rules allow a retainer to heal the damage done during
combat; they make no other provisions for healing.
